args.data: Coordinator Note: Two workstreams have been delegated for vendor SLA monitoring. 1) triage-analyst — Triage vendor SLA monitoring freshness exceptions and identify priority issues for resolution. 2) sla-analyst — Analyze vendor SLA monitoring data for compliance, freshness, and exception trends. Both workstreams are assigned to Bench Stark Enterprise.
